Troy Wainwright |stadium=[[Comcast Center (arena)|Comcast Center]] |champion= ACC Regular Season Co-Champions |bowl=[[2010 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |bowl_result=Round of 32 }} {{2009–10 ACC men's basketball standings}} The '''2009–10 Maryland Terrapins men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Maryland, College Park|University of Maryland]] in the 2009–10 [[college basketball]] season as a member of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]] (ACC). [[Gary Williams]] was in his 21st year as the team's head coach. The Terrapins finished the season 24–9, 13–3 in ACC play, to claim a share of the regular-season championship with [[2009–10 Duke Blue Devils men's basketball team|Duke]]. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2010 ACC men's basketball tournament]] to [[2009–10 Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets men's basketball team|Georgia Tech]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2010 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament]], earning a 4-seed in the Midwest Region. They defeated 13-seed [[2009–10 Houston Cougars men's basketball team|Houston]] in the first round before losing to 5-seed and AP #13 [[2009–10 Michigan State Spartans men's basketball team|Michigan State]] in the second round. In a rare double-sweep of regular-season awards, Williams was voted as the [[Atlantic Coast Conference Men's Basketball Coach of the Year|ACC Coach of the Year]] while [[Greivis Vásquez]] was named
